policy: Preserve every pinned raw text and its annotations. Exclude non-article contamination or standalone correction notices without rewriting input or resampling by class. Review is independent of sentiment class and candidate scores.

coverage: All 856 exact inputs fully read in both passes; 11 explicit source-form exclusions, no sentiment or model-score selection.
